      threaded even though juniors do not write threaded code. Cover: shared mutable state in a singleton
      `@Service` (an instance field holding per-request data corrupting under load); what a race condition

      immutable `DateTimeFormatter`/`String`); the vocabulary to recognise without writing yet
      (`Thread`, `Runnable`, `Callable`, `ExecutorService`, thread pools, Spring's `@Async`). Continues
      from 15-memory-model's stack/heap/GC material (concurrency is the next layer once memory model is
      solid) and from 01-variables-types' `StringBuilder` thread-safety callout; closes the Java notes —
      no numbered file follows it.

      why calling it inside a loop is wasteful. (c) confusable pair not contrasted: `name()` vs

      saying which one `System.out.println(role)` actually calls.

      LocalDate.of(2026,1,1)` is `false` even though it *looks* like it should work — show the labelled
      MAL/BIEN pair. Also `compareTo()` is described but never given the exact scope: it is what

      `ChronoUnit.MONTHS.between(start, end)`; same shape on `Duration` (`toHours()` is total hours,
